title: TranslateAuthorityName
description: Multilingual name enrichment for a public authority. Emitted by the translation producer (batch ETL; later the consolidator enrichment pass) after machine-translating an authority's canonical name into the supported EU languages. Self-contained by design: it carries the canonical source `name` so every sink recomposes derived state from the payload alone — the Neo4j sink sets name_<lang> properties, the embedding sink folds the translations into the searchable embed_text/name_lex and re-embeds (so keyword AND semantic search match translated names), and the Virtuoso sink mirrors them as language-tagged skos:altLabel triples via a scoped replace. Idempotent on authority_id; carries no structured attributes (country, authority_type, nuts) — those stay owned by UpsertAuthority.

authority_id.description: The Authority this enriches — the same deterministic UUID5 UpsertAuthority uses.

name.description: Canonical source name that was translated. Carried so sinks recompose embed_text/labels without reading prior state.

source_lang.description: ISO 639-1 code of the source name's language, when known (e.g. 'pl'). Sinks may record it as name_lang.

translations.description: Map of ISO 639-1 language code -> translated name. Only the supported EU languages appear; the source language may be omitted. At least one entry.
